title: Essential: Sliding determination
description: Essential Criteria: The response must correctly calculate and compare the gravitational component down the incline and the maximum static friction to conclude the phone slides down.

title: Essential: Normal force with magnet
description: Essential Criteria: The response must correctly calculate the normal force (7.2 N) when the magnetic force is applied, using the sum of the magnetic force and the perpendicular component of gravity.

title: Essential: Friction force with magnet
description: Essential Criteria: The response must correctly state the static friction force (1.6 N) when the magnetic force is applied, equaling the gravitational component down the incline.

title: Important: Force decomposition
description: Important Criteria: The response must correctly decompose the gravitational force into components parallel and perpendicular to the inclined plane.

title: Important: Equilibrium condition
description: Important Criteria: The response must apply the condition of static equilibrium (net force zero) along the incline for both parts of the problem.

title: Optional: Unit consistency check
description: Optional Criteria: The response may demonstrate consistent use of SI units (kg, m/s², N) throughout the calculations.

title: Pitfall: Incorrect normal force
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the magnetic force is incorrectly subtracted or omitted in the normal force calculation for part (2).

title: Pitfall: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if force directions (e.g., friction direction, component signs) are incorrectly assigned, leading to wrong equilibrium equations.
